Prompts

```
['load a visible and tangible box into the PyBullet simulation with custom dimensions, position, orientation, color, and mass', 'build a single stepstone in the PyBullet simulation with configurable length, height, width, gap, and color', 'build a series of uniformly sized stepstones with cycling colors for robot navigation terrain in PyBullet', 'build a series of stepstones with randomly sampled lengths, gaps, and height offsets for varied terrain in PyBullet', 'build a starting platform at the origin for the robot to stand on before navigating stepstones']
```

Usage

```
{'load_box': 'load a visible and tangible box into the PyBullet simulation with custom dimensions, position, orientation, color, and mass', 'build_one_stepstone': 'build a single stepstone in the PyBullet simulation with configurable length, height, width, gap, and color', 'build_stepstones': 'build a series of uniformly sized stepstones with cycling colors for robot navigation terrain in PyBullet', 'build_random_stepstones': 'build a series of stepstones with randomly sampled lengths, gaps, and height offsets for varied terrain in PyBullet', 'build_platform_at_origin': 'build a starting platform at the origin for the robot to stand on before navigating stepstones'}
```
